headline: Host Hotels & Resorts Publishes 2026 Corporate Responsibility Report, Highlighting Resilience, Sustainability and Community Impact
summary: BETHESDA, Md., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (NASDAQ: HST) (the “Company”), the nation’s largest lodging real estate investment trust (“REIT”), published its 2026 Corporate Responsibility (CR) Report, Investing for the Future. The report provides an overview of the Company’s CR strategy and performance, highlighting continued progress across environmental stewardship, social impact and governance in support of its long-term responsible investment strategy and 2050
